title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. a-o-a I had a dream about my uncle around a year later after his death were I see my self praying in the front row of a Friday prayer with all levels of people gathered. Then when I turn around, I see my uncle talking and laughing at his son explaining that in life he should take responsibility and that my uncle is safe and health. From physical description I see him in white cloths, well built in muscle, happy looking, with a black sheet covering his left side and stuff like kajal, topi, small beard, white skin even if he was a bit brown before death. I feel like everything isn?t right, as if I have been shown this dream to take care of his family. The first thought I had when I awake from the dream was marrying his daughter who I haven?t seen yet. What should be done, and what from your knowledge this dream really means? I was told by my parents that they are converting to chiasm and they are so young, I am in my 20ties and am not strong enough to be trusted by them. I feel really worried. By Muhammed Faizan Mustafa My second question is that I see him again in a second dream a few months later were he is looking at me in a cloudy crowd, but I am not so confident about it because it was short and more of a vision then a dream. What does this mean and what does he want me to do. Why do I see this dream when I have never lived with him by. 1543 views Q. My questions are related to dreams and I ask for interpretation, inshaAllah. 1. My mother dreamed a big snake and the snake told her, 'I will eat you'. After that the snake surrounded her body and my mother said, 'Only Allah can help me'. Then she recited Ayatul Kursi and the snake disappeared. 2. I dreamed my 70-year-old female Christian neighbour. I met her in the street at the time just before the sun raises /it wasn't neither dark, nor light/. The street was empty. My neighbour told me 'You will all burn in Hell even your young /innocent/ children'. In life she admires us and is tollerant but I am worried about what I saw in my dream. 3. I want to ask how one can interpret the dreams - is it something that is studied or it's just something given to you by Allah? 1951 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Firstly, jazak Allah for all of the questions you have answered for me. I want to remove the thought of this dream that I had a few weeks ago. At sunrise time, I went to sleep and I had this dream- before I went to sleep, I think I made du'a to Allah and said the shahadah before sleeping. I also think I had started writing a hamd (poem) and the night before I had finished, al hamdu lillah, a hamd on Asma ul husna. So I dreamt of 4 particular things. I don't know the order, but I remember seeing a lecturer talk about something to do with Islam, then all of the sudden I looked out of the window to see a beautiful scene of snow in my garden with the orangy-red night sky. Then I remember being on my prayer mat, facing the qiblah and making du'aa unto Allah. I remember supplicating Ya Mu'min (WAllahu 'alam) and I then saw a tree next to me (it was black and I think it had no leaves), it seemed like it was doing ruku' (WAllahu 'alam) and coming towards me, I kept on moving my head away and was still doing the du'aa. I woke up still mumbling the du'a. What could this mean? Jazak Allahu Khair for your continued patience. Ma' salam. 1856 views Q. Dream 1426 views Q. I am Mohammad Abdul Khadeer. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43627 Country: India Title: dream of falling into well Question: I dreamt that I had fallen into a well filled with water while driving my red car. After falling I walked out of the car and the well, and the red car sank into the water. Please provide me the clarification. Answer ID: 43627 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 306/200/L=1434) You should see your income sources. If you are getting haram or doubtful income from anywhere then you should stop it. Illegal money goes waste as it comes, while the halal and pure income has barakah and is safe against disasters even if it is less. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
